name: SFTP
description: Browse and transfer over SFTP, through the machine's own ssh: your keys, the agent and ~/.ssh/config work as they do in a terminal. Set up connections from Drives and connections.
author: xverb

fields.label: Host name
fields.hint: server.example.com, an alias from ~/.ssh/config, or a whole sftp:// URL

fields.label: User name
fields.note: Leave empty for the one ssh would use.

fields.label: Password
fields.note: Leave empty to sign in with a key or the agent.

fields.label: Private key
fields.note: Only if it is not one ssh offers already. A passphrase goes in Password.

commands.title: Disconnect all SFTP sessions
commands.description: Ends every ssh process this plugin started.

settings.label: Close a session idle for longer than
settings.note: Seconds. A closed session is opened again by the next thing that needs it.

settings.label: ssh program
settings.note: Only for an ssh that is not the one on PATH.
